telemetry_root_task_cookie.scope: every fragment; inherited launch cookie, independent of recorder scratch and parent liveness

capture.user_memory_provenance: separate observational snapshots, not atomic kernel operands
capture.exit_hook: arch/x86/entry/common.c: kernel dispatch result before exit work
capture.lineage: task cookie allocated on kernel-control launch and each descendant fork; launch root_task_cookie inherited independently of recorder scratch, transport loss and parent liveness
capture.large_objects: stream through bounded task scratch; abort current field explicitly on transport loss
capture.scratch_exhaustion: retain task cookie and lineage; increment persistent context_failures; emit child context exhaustion when parent context exists; retry context on subsequent selected entry
capture.iovec_ceiling: UIO_MAXIOV; entry descriptor snapshot retained for output; MAX_RW_COUNT for input consumption
capture.health: queryable cumulative counters via control STATS; no claim that best-effort telemetry itself closes final loss gaps

limitations: Compat i386 (ABI 0) and x32 (ABI 2) dispatches emit raw metadata plus NO_DECODER; no native pointer casts.
Kernel dispatch result is observed before final user-return work; final-result alterations do not have a second supplement.
Restart attempts are separate call identities with explicit restart result classification; no proven retry linkage.
Successful exec can renumber TID while preserving cookie; lifecycle carries current TID, not an explicit old-TID object.
No async I/O, shared-memory write, file-to-file payload or vDSO tracing.
Control request maximum is the V7 16352-byte ceiling; kernel-control argv/env must fit one request.
At most 64 terminal sessions concurrently retained; sessions observed at EOF are reclaimed by later launches.
STOP_RUN uses the inherited launch root_task_cookie, independently of PTY sessions; SIGTERM success does not prove tree completion, and concurrent forks may escape the scan.
Upload abort closes but preserves the visible partial destination; no atomic replacement transaction.
No reconnection, snapshot restore or transport ABI change.
Counter wraparound and capture performance have not been qualified.
